data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old Germanic name Sigismund, composed of Sigis (victory) and mund (protector, defender). Sigismond is a name that signifies the victory of God over the challenges and struggles of life. The name Sigismond carries the meaning “Victory of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Sigismond usually hope their child will grow to embody victory of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: Sigismond is a name of royal and heroic origin. Throughout history, numerous Christian rulers and saints bearing this name graced the realms of European monarchies. One of them, King Sigismund of Hungary (1360-1437), was known for his courage, strategic diplomacy, and support for education, arts, and sciences. Moreover, the name Sigismond evokes images of strength, resilience, and determination in the face of adversity - qualities which continue to inspire people today.
data.spiritual_significance: Sigismond translates to 'God's victory.' It is a powerful reminder that, in life, we are not fighting alone but guided and protected by the Almighty. The name encourages everyone to trust in God and believe that He will bring them through any trials or tribulations. As such, Sigismond is not just a name but an affirmation of faith and reliance on the power of the Divine.
